THIS CRL.P IS FILED U/S.439 CR.P.C PRAYING TO ENLARGE THE PETITIONER ON BAIL IN CR.NO.103/2023 OF HOSAKOTE P.S., BENGALURU DISTRICT FOR THE OFFENCE P/U/S.323,324,341,342,376,504,506 OF IPC PENDING ON THE FILE OF THE PRINCIPAL CIVIL JUDGE AND JMFC HOSAKOTE BENGALURU.

THIS PETITION IS COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Heard the learned counsel for petitioner and the learned High Court Government Pleader and perused the material available on record.
2.
Petitioner is the sole accused in Cr.No.No.103/2023 registered at Hosakote police station, for offences punishable under Sections 506, 341, 504, 376, 323, 324 and 342 IPC.

3. In the complaint lodged by the victim, she has alleged that she has successfully completed her MBBS Course in the year 2022 and during her internship in MVJ Hospital she was posted in casualty and at that time she used to ask about her doubts regarding the subject with the petitioner,
a Post Graduate in Surgery Department.

It NC: 2023:KHC:21684 is alleged that the petitioner took her to his house on 29.04.2022 and placing a hammer on her head and by threatening, raped her and thereafter, by blackmailing her, raped continuously.

It is also alleged that he is a drug addict and behaved like an animal while on drugs and he has tortured and gave life threat to her etc.
4.
The victim is a major aged about 24 years.

Allegations regarding rape, sexual assault, torture etc.,
according to the complaint has taken place from 29.04.2022.
The complaint is lodged on 11.04.2023.

It is stated that the complainant was mentally exhausted and even attempted to commit suicide several times and finally she informed her parents about the entire incident and her parents took her to the police station and then the complaint is lodged.
5.

Petitioner claims to be innocent and it is contended that there is a love affair between the victim and the petitioner and on account of some NC: 2023:KHC:21684 misunderstanding, he has been falsely implicated in the case.
6. The victim's statement has been recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. wherein she has reiterated the complaint averments.

However, her further statement has been recorded by the police on Dr. Sujith M vs State By Hoskote Police Station on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157138122/
2 15.06.2023 wherein, she has stated that both of them had a consensual sexual relationship etc.
7.

sentences.text: The victim has given two different versions.
Therefore, it cannot be said at this stage that there is a prima facie case against the petitioner for the offences alleged in the FIR.
Petitioner was arrested on 11.04.2023 and he is in judicial custody.
He has been interrogated and not required for any further investigation/interrogation.
He has undertaken to furnish adequate surety to ensure his presence before the trial Court.
Considering the facts and circumstances, petitioner can be admitted to bail by imposing necessary conditions.

Accordingly, the following:
NC: 2023:KHC:21684 ORDER 1. Petition is allowed.

2. Petitioner/accused shall be released on bail in Cr.No.103/2023 registered at Hosakote police station, subject to following conditions:
i. He shall execute a personal bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh only) with two sureties for the likesum to the satisfaction of the jurisdictional Court.
2. He shall furnish proof of his residential address and shall inform the Investigating Officer/Court, if there is any change in the address.
3. He shall make himself available for the purpose of investigation as and when called for and shall co-operate with the investigation.
4. He shall not directly or indirectly tamper with the prosecution witnesses.
He shall not indulge himself in committing any offence.
6. He shall appear before the Trial Court regularly.

7. Sd/-
